content:
We are back with our weekly update of the latest products available at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, the new MacBook Air configurations, and the Apple Watch Ultra 3.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, allowing you to purchase directly from Apple's website with savings of up to 15%.

Here is what you need to know:

  • Quality assured, great prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Comes with Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare product protection plans are available for purchase
  • Engraving and gift packaging services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store so you don't have to. Inventory changes quickly, and we hope this report helps everyone know what is currently in stock so you can grab your desired products while supplies last.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air prices remain my most recommended deals. Both are excellent choices for those entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to an Apple Silicon product.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $699 new)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299 new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699 new)

Studio Display

We first mentioned a few weeks ago that you can purchase the Studio Display XDR through the Apple Refurbished Store. As always, inventory changes quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, we have only two configurations available:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and a tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299 new)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and a tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599 new)

Apple TV 4K

The always-popular basic Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with the perpetually available higher-end Ethernet version. The basic model typically sells out quickly, so don't wait if you want one.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199 new)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249 new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear my Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day, and if you want to join the club, there are some great deals at the Apple Refurbished Store this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799 new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799 new)

As always, be sure to check out 9to5Toys throughout the week for the latest Apple deals.
